test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Only a few Adults are Plumbers.

&

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
As per the given statements, the least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a4ec1a02f7667a0be6a1d58b223cdcc09e208d25c3919e1a415acb4013d0f9d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Adults are Taxi drivers. → **Not follow**** **(Because there is no definite relation between Adults and Taxi drivers, so it can be possible only)

II. All Plumbers can never be Taxi drivers. →** Follow** (Because only a few Plumbers are Taxi drivers, which means all Plumbers can never be Taxi drivers)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion II follows".**
